title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
Accounts Payable Administrator
Location: Redditch
Salary: 26,000 per annum
Working arrangements: Hybrid working (2 days a week in the office) and flexibility

Flora Partners are recruiting for an Accounts Payable Administrator to join a friendly and supportive finance team based in Redditch.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous accounts payable or invoice processing experience who is looking to build on their existing skills or simply enjoy a better work-life balance.

The business offers a flexible working environment, with the opportunity to develop and progress for someone who wants to, although progression is certainly not an expectation.

As an Accounts Payable Administrator, you will support the day-to-day running of the purchase ledger function, ensuring invoices are processed accurately and efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and resolving discrepancies.
- Handling supplier queries and liaising with internal departments.
- Supporting supplier statement reconciliations.
- Ensuring invoices are correctly coded and authorised.
- Assisting with payment runs and maintaining accurate supplier records.
- Identifying and resolving invoice discrepancies.
- Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team.

Ideally, you will:
- Have previous accounts payable, purchase ledger or invoice processing experience.
- Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Be organised and able to manage your own workload.
- Have good communication skills and be confident handling queries.
- Be comfortable using finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Enjoy working as part of a team whilst also being able to work independently.
- Have a positive, proactive and adaptable approach.

In return, you will:
- Receive a salary of 26,000 per annum.
- Benefit from hybrid working and flexibility.
- Join a friendly and supportive finance team.
- Enjoy a good work-life balance.
- Have the opportunity to develop your skills and progress, should you wish to.

Interested?

Please apply with your CV for further information.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper Droitwich

Salary: 28,000 to 40,000 (dependent on experience)
Ref: BCR/JC/32588
Location: Droitwich

Bell Cornwall Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Bookkeeper to join a growing organisation based in Droitwich. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a small, friendly team and develop your finance skills within a varied and fast-paced environment.

The opportunity

Are you a numerate, organised individual with an eye for detail and an interest in finance? This Bookkeeper role offers the chance to build on your existing experience, develop your knowledge of Xero and gain exposure to a broad range of financial activities. Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the smooth running of the finance function.

What you'll be doing

As the Bookkeeper, you will:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records using Xero accounting software.
- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
- Complete general ledger reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
- Record journal entries in line with double-entry bookkeeping principles.
- Assist with preparing financial reports, including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements.
- Analyse financial data to identify inconsistencies or irregularities.
- Maintain organised records of transactions and expenses to support tax preparation.
- Use spreadsheets for financial analysis and reporting.
- Assist with month-end procedures and audit preparation as required.

About you
- Previous experience in bookkeeping or a similar finance or accounting role.
- An understanding of accounting software, ideally Xero or a similar system.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence using spreadsheets.
- An understanding of debits and credits, double-entry bookkeeping and account reconciliations.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
- Strong analytical and communication skills.
- A proactive attitude, with a willingness to learn and develop within a supportive team.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Finance Assistant
Location: Worcester Salary: £27,000
Working pattern: Hybrid, three days in the office and two days from home
Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm
Job type: Permanent, full-time
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant looking for a broader role with exposure to month-end accounting?
An established and successful organisation based in the Worcester area is looking to recruit a Finance Assistant into its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with transactional finance experience who would like to develop their knowledge of balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, prepayments and international accounting.
The position offers a varied workload covering purchase ledger, bank reconciliations, expenses, and month-end support. You will work closely with an experienced finance team and have the opportunity to develop your accounting knowledge while taking ownership of several important processes.
Your new role
- Processing purchase invoices and maintaining accurate ledger records
- Reviewing the purchase ledger and resolving supplier queries
- Preparing supplier payment runs and ensuring payments are made in line with agreed terms
- Completing daily bank reconciliations
- Supporting the month-end process
- Assisting with balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments
- Raising intercompany invoices and completing intercompany reconciliations
- Preparing information to support VAT returns
- Producing expenditure analysis and spend-versus-budget reports
- Supporting customer invoice queries and processing approved credit notes

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Assistant Accountant or similar position
- Practical experience across purchase ledger, cash book or nominal ledger accounting
- Experience completing bank reconciliations
- An understanding of accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations
- Good Excel skills, including the ability to create and manipulate spreadsheets
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload
- A proactive, flexible and team-focused approach

An AAT qualification or current AAT studies would be advantageous but are not essential. Additional language skills would also be useful, although they are not required.
What you'll get in return
- Salary of £27,000
- Hybrid working, with three days in the office and two days from home
- A 35-hour working week
- Broad exposure across transactional finance and month-end accounting
- Support from an established finance team
- The opportunity to develop towards a more senior accounting position

This role would be particularly suitable for an experienced transactional finance professional who is ready to broaden their responsibilities and gain more meaningful month-end exposure.
What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

An initial 6 month role with possibility of going permanent

Up to 27k + increments upon completing training

5 days on site for 3 months

Location: Worcestershire

Hours: Full-Time, 37.5 Hours per Week (Monday to Friday)

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Payroll Administrator to join their Finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented and organised professional looking to develop their career within payroll, supporting both UK and international payroll operations.

Working closely with an experienced payroll team, you will help ensure payrolls are processed accurately, compliantly and on time, while providing a high standard of service to internal stakeholders, contractors and external providers.

The Role

The successful candidate will support the delivery of an effective payroll service across multiple payrolls and jurisdictions.

Key responsibilities include:
- Assisting with the accurate and timely processing of payrolls.
- Working alongside senior payroll colleagues to ensure payroll deadlines are met.
- Liaising with employees, contractors and external providers to resolve payroll-related queries.
- Supporting the administration of international payrolls through third-party payroll providers.
- Assisting with compliance requirements and payroll documentation for overseas jurisdictions.
- Ensuring timesheets, invoices and expense information are received and processed on schedule.
- Maintaining payroll records and systems with a high degree of accuracy.
- Monitoring payroll processes and identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Supporting business managers by communicating payroll issues and contractor-related concerns.
- Keeping informed of relevant legislative changes affecting payroll, tax and employment practices.
- Providing excellent customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.

About You

We are seeking a highly organised individual with strong administrative skills, excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workloads effectively.
- Strong customer service focus.
- Ability to investigate and resolve problems logically.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Experience
- A minimum of 12 months' payroll experience or experience in a similar finance or administration role.
- Exposure to payroll systems and payroll processing.
- Experience working with international payrolls would be advantageous.

Qualifications

GCSEs (or equivalent) including English Language and Mathematics at Grade C/4 or above.

Additional Advantage

Spanish language skills would be highly advantageous, particularly when supporting international payroll activities and communicating with overseas stakeholders.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing and collaborative organisation where you will gain exposure to both UK and international payroll operations. The role offers variety, responsibility and the chance to develop specialist payroll knowledge while working alongside experienced professionals.

If you are an organised administrator with payroll experience and a passion for accuracy and customer service, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for a confidential discussion.

title: Payroll Administrator

Redditch £30,000 Full Time, Permanent
